interface.signature: def numBusesToDestination(routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(route, list) and all(isinstance(stop, int) for stop in route) for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each route is a non-empty list of integers representing bus stops, and all stops are non-negative integers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(route) >= 1 for route in routes) and len(routes) >= 1
preconditions.description: There is at least one bus route, and each route has at least one stop.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, int) and isinstance(T, int) and S >= 0 and T >= 0
preconditions.description: S and T are non-negative integers representing starting and target bus stops.

preconditions.expression: S != T or any(S in route for route in routes)
preconditions.description: If S equals T, the answer is 0 only if S is reachable by some route (i.e., S is in at least one route). Otherwise, the answer is -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 and S == T and any(S in route for route in routes)
postconditions.description: If S equals T and S is reachable by some route, return 0 (no buses needed).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 and not any(T in route for route in routes)
postconditions.description: If T is not reachable by any route, return -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value >= 1 and return_value <= len(routes) and any(all(stop not in route for route in routes) for stop in [S, T])
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, return the minimum number of buses (1 ≤ return_value ≤ total routes) required to reach T from S, where S and T are not on the same route initially.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 1 and all(not (S in route and T in route) for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If S and T are on the same route, return -1 (invalid case per P4), otherwise return the minimal buses or -1 if unreachable.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 1 and any(S in route for route in routes) and any(T in route for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, S must be on at least one route and T must be on at least one route.
